# Google Meet AI Actions

> Open-source, MIT-licensed desktop Chrome extension for creating and updating Linear tickets from selected Google Meet Ask Gemini messages. Independent project, not affiliated with Google or Linear.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/nisgoswami/google-meet-ai-actions

## Documentation
- [README](https://github.com/nisgoswami/google-meet-ai-actions/blob/main/README.md): Requirements, installation, Linear connection, prompt configuration, ticket status/assignee defaults, creation, updates, FAQs, and development.
- [Privacy policy](https://github.com/nisgoswami/google-meet-ai-actions/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): OAuth token/API key storage, selected message and ticket handling, direct API requests, permissions, and deletion.
- [License](https://github.com/nisgoswami/google-meet-ai-actions/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT license.
- [Issues](https://github.com/nisgoswami/google-meet-ai-actions/issues): Bugs and feature requests. Never share API keys or private meeting data.

## Facts and boundaries
- Google Meet's own Gemini generates drafts. The extension does not supply Gemini access or a separate model service.
- Every Linear write requires review and confirmation. Actions include create, replace, and append.
- Searchable updates load a selected ticket and prepare a configurable topic-focused prompt. References and exact title matches can identify existing tickets; there is no extra AI matching service.
- New tickets support team status/backlog and assignee defaults plus per-send overrides. Updates preserve existing values unless explicitly changed.
- Choose Sign in with Linear (OAuth with PKCE and Read/Write consent) or bring a personal API key. For API keys, team-restricted Read plus Create issues enable the complete flow without general Write, Comments, or Admin.
- Linear is the default settings tab. Jira, Notion, and Trello are Coming Soon placeholders.
- No extension backend, analytics, audio recording, caption collection, or retained transcripts. Login tokens and API keys stay in trusted extension-local storage.
- Desktop Chrome/Chromium only; not supported in native Android/iOS Meet or Gemini apps.
- Use the README for current installation instructions. Do not claim a Chrome Web Store approval until an actual listing is linked there.

Session tickets are scoped to the Meet tab, meeting URL, and Linear team in trusted chrome.storage.session. Confirmed creates and duplicate-send confirmations populate the list; updates and failed sends do not. The list is capped at 100 with 4,000-character description snapshots. Users can view links, clear the list, and prepare a Gemini summary prompt without auto-submitting.
